distinguishing_features: Protects the hydro-transport pipe wall with an internal compliant polyurethane or nylon-polyurethane layer rather than predicting erosion from operating data.
Relies on the layer’s wear resistance and deformation to mitigate bed-load damage, rather than on current-signature integration or condition monitoring.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce sliding-bed-load erosion of a hydro-transport pipe wall while preserving its structural integrity.
parsed.viable_reason: A polyurethane lining of the stated thickness is a practicable slurry-wear barrier, although the claimed 100-fold stress reduction is not established by the modulus comparison or equations given.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Compliant polymer linings are a familiar alternative for slurry abrasion protection, so applying one to the pipe is an evident material choice for this erosion problem.
